description: Conway governance-signature phase-1 differential family (cardano-node vs Amaru). Reachable slice: gov-cert REQUIRED-WITNESS validation via DRep-registration certs (not-registered is the correct pre-state, so only the UTXOW witness rule applies - no pre-existing DRep/proposal needed). Committee hot-key auth (script-hash committee) and DRep VOTING (needs a registered DRep + open action in both frozen stores) are NOT reachable on this substrate - see the scenario doc. All cases spend the committed funding UTxO; fee 300000 >> min. Violations idempotent; satisfied controls single-use. Result 2026-09-26: all cases AGREE (amaru 0903 ea1f34e4 conformant with cardano-node 11.1.2; both cite MissingVKeyWitness for the SAME governance credential).
